Envoy proxy configuration for mutual TLS compliance across internal microservices. Inspect file reference @gateway/envoy.yaml and review @certs/tls_policy.json. Our edge routing clusters terminate client connections using upstream clusters configured with strict TLS 1.3. When client applications initiate mTLS handshakes, Envoy validates client certificates against our intermediate root certificate authority. In @gateway/envoy.yaml, configure common TLS context to set require_client_certificate to true and enable ALPN protocols h2 and http/1.1. Ensure that @certs/tls_policy.json specifies allowed Subject Alternative Names, strictly restricting access to authenticated backend services. Certificate revocation lists in @crl_manager.py must refresh dynamic certificate bundles every 6 hours without terminating active client connections. Site reliability engineers must monitor TLS handshake latency on the primary Grafana dashboard, keeping p99 handshake duration below 10 milliseconds. If an untrusted client certificate presents invalid signature chains, Envoy must immediately reject the connection with TLS alert unknown CA. The security operations lead mandates logging all failed TLS handshake events to @audit_access.log with client IP address and cipher suite details. The platform security architect mandates verifying that weak ciphers, including RSA key exchange and CBC mode, are completely disabled. TLS session resumption in @session_cache.cpp must configure session ticket encryption keys, rotating key secrets every 24 hours across all gateway nodes. The load balancing tier in @cluster_manager.yaml must configure active health checking, sending HTTP GET probes every 5 seconds to origin clusters. The network security team mandates enforcing OCSP stapling in @certificate_resolver.py to verify real-time certificate revocation status without client latency penalties. Client certificate validation hooks in @cert_validator.py must verify that certificate extended key usage extensions contain client authentication flags. Upstream endpoint health status in @endpoint_health.yaml must record connection success ratios across 10 consecutive probe attempts before marking endpoints healthy. The infrastructure team requires automated integration tests simulating certificate expiration and rotation cycles before approving production deployment. The network operations center requires 24/7 monitoring of Envoy proxy buffer utilization. The infrastructure operations director requires benchmark load tests demonstrating 40,000 active mTLS client connections before approving production rollout. The security incident response team requires real-time alerting on ingress TLS negotiation failures exceeding 100 events per minute."}]
